mapper.insert: INSERT INTO edudoc_qa_session (id, document_id, user_id, title, status) VALUES (HEXTORAW(#{session.id}), HEXTORAW(#{session.documentId}), HEXTORAW(#{session.userId}), #{session.title, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{session.status})
mapper.select: SELECT RAWTOHEX(s.id) AS id, RAWTOHEX(s.document_id) AS documentId, RAWTOHEX(s.user_id) AS userId, s.title, s.status FROM edudoc_qa_session s WHERE s.id = HEXTORAW(#{idHex})

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT RAWTOHEX(s.id) AS id, RAWTOHEX(s.document_id) AS documentId, RAWTOHEX(s.user_id) AS userId, s.title, s.status FROM edudoc_qa_session s WHERE s.document_id = HEXTORAW(#{documentIdHex}) AND s.user_id = HEXTORAW(#{userIdHex}) AND s.status = 'A' ORDER BY s.create_time DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT RAWTOHEX(s.id) AS id, RAWTOHEX(s.document_id) AS documentId, RAWTOHEX(s.user_id) AS userId, s.title, s.status FROM edudoc_qa_session s WHERE s.document_id = HEXTORAW(#{documentIdHex}) AND s.user_id = HEXTORAW(#{userIdHex}) ORDER BY s.create_time DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 50
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO edudoc_qa_message (id, session_id, role, content_text, ai_task_id, sequence_no, status)
SELECT HEXTORAW(#{m.id}), HEXTORAW(#{m.sessionId}), #{m.role}, #{m.contentText, jdbcType=CLOB}, HEXTORAW(#{m.aiTaskId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}), #{m.sequenceNo}, #{m.status} FROM DUAL
mapper.select: SELECT MAX(sequence_no) FROM edudoc_qa_message WHERE session_id = HEXTORAW(#{sessionIdHex})

SELECT RAWTOHEX(m.id) AS id, RAWTOHEX(m.session_id) AS sessionId, m.role, m.content_text AS contentText, RAWTOHEX(m.ai_task_id) AS aiTaskId, m.sequence_no AS sequenceNo, m.status FROM edudoc_qa_message m WHERE m.session_id = HEXTORAW(#{sessionIdHex}) ORDER BY m.sequence_no
